description: Ranged demolitionist - stacks napalm on a target and then sets the whole pile alight.
_source_note: Rebuilt 5 Nov 2026 from data/reference/coa/tinker.json tab 73 (38 real CoA Demolition talents) with identity from reference/coa_sidekick ('Closest to Survival Hunter, reflavored fully ranged'). Replaces a 22-node tree carrying real CoA names on 21 pure-scalar effects, and which had no Napalm mechanic at all despite Napalm being what the spec is built around.

nodes.name: Incendiary Bullets
nodes.description:
Increases the damage of Scrap Shot by up to 15% and your chance to hit by
    up to 3%.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Increases the damage of Scrap Shot by 15% and increases your chance to hit by 2%.'

nodes.name: Bomb Builder
nodes.description: Increases Fire damage dealt by you and your constructs by 3%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your and your summons Fire Damage dealt by 5%.'

nodes.name: Boom Hour
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Bomb Toss by 9% and the critical damage of Rocket Launcher by 9%.
nodes._source: CoA has TWO near-identical nodes here - Boom Hour ('crit chance of Bomb Toss and Firepot Drone by 10%') and Buster Scope ('critical damage of Rocket Launcher by 10%'). With ~22 picks in a turn-based tree, two separate crit passives is one decision wearing two hats, so they are merged. Firepot Drone has no ability here.

nodes.name: Explosives Expert
nodes.description: Your critical strikes and your constructs' restore mana.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Direct harmful ability critical strikes from you or your summons now restores 4% of your maximum mana.' Replaces a pure-scalar node of the same name.

nodes.name: Tank Buster
nodes.description: Your Scrap Shot ignores 24% of the target's armor.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Scrap Shot now ignores 25% of the target's Armor when damaging Burning targets.' The burning condition is not expressible - there is no per-ability conditional armor pen - so it applies flat, which is a real buff over CoA and is said so here rather than hidden.

nodes.name: War Crimes
nodes.description: Bomb Toss coats the target in napalm, increasing Fire damage it takes by 3% and reducing healing it receives by 3% for 3 turns, stacking 10 times.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Explosive Augmentation and Tracer Augmentation now has a 50% chance to apply an additional stack of Napalm.' Moved onto Bomb Toss and made reliable: this is the node that INTRODUCES Napalm to the tree, and a 50% chance on two augmentations would leave the spec's defining debuff absent most fights. 8 sec -> 3 turns.

nodes.name: Sparked and Ready!
nodes.description: Your Fire damage has a 15% chance to ready a Rocket Launcher, resetting its cooldown.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Fire damage dealt has a 5% chance to grant Sparked and Ready!, causing your next Rocket Launcher within 10 sec to be instant cast and deal 20% increased damage.' Instant-cast means nothing here, so the payoff is the cooldown reset; 5% -> 15% because a turn is far longer than a real-time GCD and 5% per CAST would almost never fire. Replaces a pure-scalar node.

nodes.name: I Need More Explosions!
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Sticky Bomb by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim. Was already a scalar in CoA, so it stays one. SPLIT from 1 rank of 15% into 3 ranks of 5% - the same ceiling, not a buff. The tree needed more points in its lower tiers to make its own top tiers reachable at all: tier_requirements gate tier 5 at 25 points and tier 6 at 30, and the rebuilt tree held 27 points in total with 24 below tier 5, so both tiers were dead. See tools/qa_talent_tiers_reachable.py.

nodes.name: Machine Synergy
nodes.description: Scrap Shot drives your constructs harder, raising their damage by 5% for 2 turns, stacking 3 times.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Scrap Shot now adds a stack of Machine Synergy to your active pet and Sentry Turret... 5% damage and 3% haste, stacking 3 times, for 6 seconds.' Pet haste is not a key here, so the damage half carries it. 6 sec -> 2 turns.

nodes.name: Drone Striker
nodes.description: Scrap Shot drives another stack of napalm into the target.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Firepot Drone and Scrap Shot now deal 2% increased damage for each stack of Napalm on the enemy.' NOT built as written, and deliberately. That per-stack scaling already lives on the ABILITY (tinker_scrap_shot carries scales_with_target_stacks_of + damage_per_stack_pct 0.02) and applies whether or not this talent is spent; there is no effect key that switches it on, so a node claiming to grant it would grant nothing. Deleting the node was the other option and is what tinker_scrap_shot's own note assumed - but three nodes connect through this slot. So the node keeps CoA's INTENT, 'Scrap Shot gets more out of Napalm', via the half that is buildable: it puts more Napalm on the target, which the ability's native scaling then reads. Third Napalm applier in the tree, matching CoA, which also has three.

nodes.name: Aftermath
nodes.description: Casting Sticky Bomb makes your next attacks hit 25% harder.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Sticky Bomb now causes your next 2 Scrap Shots within 10 seconds to cast -50% faster and deal 25% increased damage.' Cast speed is meaningless here; the damage half becomes a 2-turn buff.

nodes.name: Target Acquired
nodes.description: Your Sticky Bomb and Spider Bomb deal 15% more damage per rank to a lone target.
nodes._source: CoA: '...30% increased damage when it strikes only 1 target.' There is no single-target conditional on an ability's damage here, so it applies always. Stated plainly: this is stronger than CoA's.

nodes.name: Duobombers
nodes.description: Build: Spider Bomb sends out a second bomb, dealing 54% more damage.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Build: Spider Bomb now creates an additional Spider Bomb.' Two bombs is twice the damage, and doubling the ability is a far simpler truth than modelling a second summon.

nodes.name: Grenadier
nodes.description: When napalm reaches 5 stacks the target ignites, taking Fire damage over 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'When you reach 5 stacks of Napalm on a target you refresh 1 charge of Build: Firepot Drone.' No Firepot Drone and no charges here, so the payoff is reflavoured as the fire it would have delivered. The 5-stack condition is not expressible either; a 2-turn internal cooldown stands in for the pacing.

nodes.name: Bombastic
nodes.description: Casting Build: Spider Bomb resets the cooldown of Bomb Toss.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Build: Spider Bomb now resets the cooldown of Bomb Toss and causes your next Bomb Toss within 15 seconds to trigger no cooldown, global cooldown, or cost.' The reset ports exactly; the free-cast rider is the same effect twice in an engine with no GCD, so it is dropped.

nodes.name: Rocket Engineering
nodes.description: Your critical strikes drive another stack of napalm into the target.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Direct harmful ability critical strikes now apply an additional stack of Tracer Augmentation to the target.' Tracer Augmentation's own stacking mark is not modelled; routed into Napalm, which is the stacking mark this tree actually has.

nodes.name: Surprise Launch!
nodes.description: Rocket Launcher always critically strikes targets coated in napalm.
nodes._source: CoA: 'When Rocket Launcher is used on enemies affected by Sticky Bomb it is now guaranteed to critically strike.' The condition cannot be expressed, so this is a flat guaranteed crit on one ability - powerful, and deliberately placed at tier 4 behind two napalm nodes to keep the fantasy intact even though the engine will not enforce it.

nodes.name: Gazlowe's Wisdom
nodes.description: Sticky Bomb deals 12% more damage, and all of your area attacks deal 15% more.
nodes._source: CoA: 'You now spawn 2 Shrapnel Mines under your target when Sticky Bomb explodes.' Ground-placed mines and Remote Detonation do not exist here; the shrapnel is expressed as the splash it represents. Replaces a pure-scalar node of the same name.

nodes.name: The BIG Guns!
nodes.description: Increases your attack power by up to 6%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the attack power of all party and raid members 5%. Does not stack with similar effects. In addition, increases your ranged attack power by 3%.' Party-wide auras are not modelled, so only the self half is live - the description keeps the party wording because that is the talent's identity, and it is the one place here where flavour text outruns the mechanic.

nodes.name: Bomb Squad
nodes.description: Increases your spell power by 51% of your Agility.
nodes._source: CoA verbatim: 'Level 40 Passive. Increases your Fire spell power by 50% of Agility.' A stat conversion, which this engine handles natively through <target>_from_<source>_pct - but only for the targets in STAT_CONVERSION_TARGETS, and there is no per-school spell power in this engine, only spell_power. So the SCHOOL half is dropped rather than faked: an unknown pairing is skipped silently by character.py, which is the Clarity of the Heavens bug recorded in that dict's own comment. The value is a FRACTION (gained = source * pct), so 0.50, not 50.0 - as written it was a 5000% conversion.

nodes.name: Rocket Pack
nodes.description: Your Fire critical strikes cut the cooldown of your heaviest ordnance.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Fire critical strikes now reduce the remaining cooldown of Rockadier by 3 sec.' There is no partial-cooldown-reduction proc payload - only reset_cooldown - so this resets on a 1-turn internal cooldown instead, pointed at Hyperblast Barrage, which is the big cooldown this kit actually has.

nodes.name: Rockadier
nodes.description: Your Scrap Shot and Rocket Launcher deal 54% more damage.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Empowers the next 6 Scrap Shots or Rocket Launchers within 30 sec to deal additional Fire damage equal to 100% of the damage dealt to up to 10 enemies around the target.' A 3-minute cooldown window is not a talent shape this tree supports, so the capstone grants the empowerment permanently at the cost of being the last pick. Replaces a pure-scalar node of the same name. The splash half is DROPPED, not approximated: aoe_damage was on this node and did nothing for it, because neither tinker_scrap_shot nor tinker_rocket_launcher is is_aoe - aoe_damage would have buffed other abilities entirely, while the prose promised a splash that never happened. 'Nearby enemies' is also positional language in an engine with no positions.

nodes.name: Bomb Toss
nodes.description: Learn Bomb Toss. Lob a bomb that burns the target over several turns.
nodes._source: Placed at tier 0 and wired into War Crimes on purpose: War Crimes procs Napalm off Bomb Toss, so the ability has to be learnable before the node that cashes it in. Was tier 1.

nodes.name: Rocket Launcher
nodes.description: Learn Rocket Launcher. A heavy fire rocket aimed at one target.
nodes._source: Also unlocked by the old Invention tree, which is wrong for a healer spec - it is a fire damage ability and Demolition is the ranged DPS tree, so it lives here only.

nodes.name: Build: Spider Bomb
nodes.description: Learn Build: Spider Bomb. Builds a walking bomb that detonates among several enemies.
nodes._source: Duobombers doubles this ability's damage, so it has to be learnable in the same tree. Same tier as before.

nodes.name: Hyperblast Barrage
nodes.description: Learn Hyperblast Barrage. Empties everything you have into a crowd at once.
nodes._source: Moved from tier 6 to tier 4 deliberately. Rocket Pack sits at tier 5 and its whole effect is resetting this ability's cooldown; with the unlock at tier 6 you could take the reset two tiers before you could take the thing being reset.
